qualificationPolicy: Do not infer an absence of all awards. 'No qualifying award verified' only describes the documented screening as of lastReviewedOn. Specific location and time of honor matter. Chef awards at another restaurant do not qualify this venue. Visit confirmation is independent of award verification.
auditGuidance: On each review check official Michelin Guide restaurant pages and regional editions, the James Beard Foundation semifinalist, finalist, and winner announcements, and reliable award archives for the actual restaurant/chef relationship. Record organization, category, recognition year, date confirmed, recipient, exact location, URL, and whether the distinction occurred before or after the meal. If newly qualified, update the main record's editorial/curation, document the honor in data/dining-awards-audit.json, mark this entry promoted, and keep the previous reviewHistory and memory. Do not infer a meal date from a reservation.
